annotations.title: Get a payment account's balance at a date

description: Balance of one check account as the sum of every transaction sevdesk knows up to and including the given date. May differ from the real bank balance if older transactions were never imported. sevdesk: GET /CheckAccount/{checkAccountId}/getBalanceAtDate.

date.description: Consider transactions up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive to 23:59:59).

name: sevdesk_get_check_account_balance
title: Get a payment account's balance at a date
